lead.t:
5- Mid arm circumference (MAC)
*In a baby 1-4 years ~ MACis>14cm
* In subclinical malnutrition ~ MACis12-14cm
* In clinical malnutrition ~ MAC is < 12 em
~Value: Early indicator of malnutrition; measure the muscle bulk and is not
affected by edema.
